text:
## Process Overview  
```
Closure Request Received
↓
Verify Customer Identity
↓
Calculate Final Balance
↓
Process Standing Orders/Direct Debits
↓
Closure Type Assessment (Customer vs. Bank-Initiated)
↓
├─ Customer-Initiated: Process normally
└─ Bank-Initiated: Investigate, document reason
↓
Transfer/Remit Final Balance
↓
Issue Closure Confirmation
↓
Archive Records (6 years)
↓
Account Marked "Closed" in System
```  
**Timeline:** 3–5 business days (customer-initiated), Immediate (bank-initiated with notice)

raw_entities.name: Account Closure Process
raw_entities.description: End-to-end procedure for closing a customer account, encompassing identity verification, final balance calculation, standing order and direct debit processing, closure type assessment, balance remittance, and record archival. Applies to both customer-initiated and bank-initiated closures with different timelines and investigation requirements.
context: Timeline: 3–5 business days (customer-initiated), Immediate (bank-initiated with notice)

raw_entities.name: Closure Request Reception
raw_entities.description: Initial step where a closure request is received from the customer or initiated by the bank. This triggers the account closure workflow.

raw_entities.name: Customer Identity Verification
raw_entities.description: Verification step to confirm the identity of the customer requesting account closure or the authorized representative initiating a bank-led closure.

raw_entities.name: Final Balance Calculation
raw_entities.description: Computation of the account's final balance, including all accrued interest, fees, and pending transactions as of the closure date.

raw_entities.name: Standing Order and Direct Debit Processing
raw_entities.description: Processing and cancellation of any active standing orders and direct debit mandates on the account prior to closure.

raw_entities.name: Closure Type Assessment
raw_entities.description: Determination of whether the closure is customer-initiated or bank-initiated, which determines the subsequent workflow path and investigation requirements.

raw_entities.name: Bank-Initiated Closure Investigation
raw_entities.description: Investigation and formal documentation of the reason for bank-initiated account closure, required before proceeding with closure.

raw_entities.name: Final Balance Transfer and Remittance
raw_entities.description: Transfer or remittance of the calculated final balance to the customer via their nominated payment method or account.

raw_entities.name: Closure Confirmation Issuance
raw_entities.description: Issuance of formal written confirmation to the customer documenting the account closure, final balance, and closure date.

raw_entities.name: Record Archival
raw_entities.description: Archival of all account records and documentation for the mandatory retention period of 6 years in compliance with regulatory requirements.

raw_entities.name: Account Status Update to Closed
raw_entities.description: Final system update marking the account status as closed, preventing any further transactions or activity on the account.

raw_entities.name: Closure Type Determination Gate
raw_entities.description: Branching decision point that determines whether the closure is customer-initiated (standard processing path) or bank-initiated (investigation and documentation required path).

raw_entities.name: Customer Account
raw_entities.description: The customer account subject to closure, which transitions from active status through the closure process to final closed status in the system.

raw_entities.name: Account Closure Requestor
raw_entities.description: The customer or authorized representative initiating or subject to account closure, whose identity must be verified and who receives the final balance and closure confirmation.

raw_entities.name: Standing Order
raw_entities.description: Active standing order payment instructions on the account that must be processed and cancelled as part of the account closure procedure.

raw_entities.name: Direct Debit Mandate
raw_entities.description: Active direct debit mandates on the account that must be processed and cancelled prior to account closure.

raw_entities.name: Operations Staff - Account Closure
raw_entities.description: Operations team responsible for executing the account closure process steps, including identity verification, balance calculation, standing order/direct debit processing, and record archival.

raw_entities.name: Bank-Initiated Closure Investigator
raw_entities.description: Compliance or operations staff responsible for investigating and documenting the reason for bank-initiated account closures.
